in_marathi.name: Chinu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'chinna' meaning 'grace, beauty, or young'. In Hindu mythology, Chinu is a playful name for the god Ganesha, who is known for his grace and beauty.
